notes: Fetched with WebFetch on 2026-10-13. Blocked or empty: /profile/ss/orderlookup and /cart (robots disallowed), /identity/global/signin (empty JS shell), /gift-card-balance (JS shell, no headings), the HTML site map (site-map URLs errored) and the JS-rendered Shop/Menu drawer contents (its department entries were reconstructed from the captured department pages and the Top Deals / Outlet category tiles). Stand-ins: sign-in, cart and product/search expectations come from research/bestbuy.md (browser capture 2026-09-29/30); order-lookup and gift-card-balance labels are the standard Best Buy form labels (unverified wording); the department tree comes from the captured TV, Video Games and Computers department pages plus the Top Deals and Outlet category tiles. Category paths whose numeric IDs were not observed keep the real URL shape with a slug only. The sitemap.xml index (76 product/review/category sitemaps) was fetched; the clone serves its own /sitemap.xml and an HTML /sitemap. Seasonal header promos (Fall Football, Halloween links) and social icons were skipped. Off-site footer links (corporate.bestbuy.com, jobs.bestbuy.com, bestbuyads.com, healthcare.bestbuy.com) map to local summary pages. Store assortment (2026-10-13): the live homepage product carousels are rendered client-side and did not come through WebFetch, so the homepage rows (Top Deals, Deal of the Day, Trending deals with category tabs, new video games, customer favorites, gifts under $100, Outlet open-box) follow the usual bestbuy.com homepage layout. stores/bestbuy/shelf-data.js lists 312 products with real brands, model numbers and representative prices across the departments Best Buy sells; they are not live offers and carry no catalog evidence. The GTA VI pre-orders appear inside the video games row, search, the Video Games department and the franchise hub.
